veg.n: Wang Chi's dan dan noodles with crisp mushroom
veg.make_ahead: Fry the crisp mushroom and tofu up to 2 days ahead, keep chilled and reheat in the wok; mix the sauce in the bowls and cook the noodles on the night

steps.text: Put a large pot of water on to boil. Slice the spring onions, rinse and chop the mustard greens, finely chop the mushrooms and crumble the tofu.

Heat the vegetable oil in a wok and fry the mushrooms and tofu over high heat for 12 minutes until dry and browning. Add the mustard greens, Sichuan pepper and 1 tbsp of the soy sauce and fry 2 minutes more until crisp.
Divide the sesame paste, chilli oil, black vinegar and remaining soy sauce between four bowls and stir each with 2 tbsp of the hot water.
Cook the wheat noodles for 2 to 3 minutes, drain and pile on top of the sauce.
Spoon over the crisp mushroom, scatter with spring onion and toss at the table.

veg.n: Pork-Chop Express char siu mushroom ribs
veg.make_ahead: Marinate the night before

steps.text: Score the cut side of the king oyster mushrooms in a criss-cross. Mash the hoisin, honey, soy, five spice, bean curd, garlic and oil together and rub over the mushrooms, keeping a few spoonfuls back for glazing.
Marinate in the fridge for at least 4 hours, overnight is better.
Lay the mushrooms cut side up in a roasting tin, cover with foil and roast at 180C.
Uncover, brush with the saved glaze and blast at 220C until sticky and charred at the edges.
Rest for a few minutes before serving.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 2 days, reheat to serve

steps.text: Brown the mushrooms in the oil in batches in a camp oven or heavy pot.
Add the onion, carrots, potatoes, stock, soy sauce, thyme and pepper.
Cover and cook over coals or at 160C until the potatoes are tender.
Stir through the butter beans and cook uncovered until the stew thickens.

veg.make_ahead: Cut the steaks and make the creamed spinach up to 1 day ahead and keep both chilled; sear, roast and rewarm the spinach on the night

steps.text: Heat the oven to 200C. Cut two thick steaks, about 3cm, from the centre of each cauliflower and season with the salt.
Sear the steaks in the oil in a hot ovenproof pan for 4 minutes a side, then add the butter, thyme and garlic and baste. Move the pan to the oven and roast until tender in the middle.
While they roast, wilt the spinach, squeeze it dry and simmer with the cream and nutmeg.
Serve the steaks with the creamed spinach and spoon over the pan butter.

veg.make_ahead: Tomato onions up to 2 days ahead

steps.text: Slice the onions.
Cook the onions in the butter over medium-low heat until soft.
Add the tomatoes and simmer.
Heat the vegetarian frankfurts in barely simmering water for 3 minutes, drain and griddle until browned. Warm the sauerkraut and steam the buns.
Assemble with mustard and the tomato onions.

veg.n: Quick's late-night fried cauliflower and waffles
veg.make_ahead: Soak the cauliflower in the buttermilk up to 1 day ahead in the fridge; make the batter and fry on the night

steps.text: Soak the cauliflower florets in 300 ml of the buttermilk with a good pinch of salt.
Leave to soak in the fridge for at least 1 hour.
Whisk 250 g of the flour with the baking powder, eggs, remaining buttermilk and 60 g of the butter, melted, into a waffle batter.
Season the remaining flour with salt and dredge the cauliflower in it, pressing it on well.
Fry the cauliflower in the oil at 170C in batches until deep golden and tender, about 5 minutes a batch.
Cook the waffles in a waffle iron.
Serve with maple syrup and the remaining butter melted with the hot sauce.

veg.make_ahead: Salsa up to 2 hours ahead, haloumi fresh

steps.text: Dice the pineapple and onion and mix with lime juice for the salsa. Mix the sour cream with lime for the crema.
Dust the haloumi in the chilli and cumin and pan-fry in the oil until golden on both sides. Cut into strips.
Warm the tortillas and shred the cabbage.
Fill the tortillas with cabbage, haloumi, salsa and crema.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 1 day, keep chilled

steps.text: Pat the chickpeas dry, toss with the oil and 1 tsp of the curry powder and roast at 200C for 15 minutes until firm.
Cool.
Mix the mayonnaise, yoghurt, remaining curry powder, jam and sultanas and fold through the chickpeas.
Serve with rice and salad leaves.

veg.make_ahead: Vegetables and stock up to 1 day ahead, cook the cauliflower fresh

steps.text: Heat the oven to 180C. Rub the cauliflower with the oil, salt and pepper and brown it all over in a heavy casserole.
Tuck the onions, carrots, garlic and potatoes around it. Whisk the tomato paste and soy into the stock, pour in, cover and braise.
Uncover, baste the cauliflower with the stock and roast until golden and a knife slides in easily.
Cut the cauliflower into wedges and serve with the vegetables and stock.

veg.make_ahead: Best fresh

steps.text: Score the cut side of the mushrooms and brush with some of the butter mixed with crushed garlic.
Boil the potatoes. Steam the green beans.
Grill the mushrooms for about 4 minutes a side until golden, brushing with more garlic butter.
Toss the potatoes and beans with the rest of the butter and serve with lemon wedges.

veg.n: Retro roast cauliflower with glazed carrots
veg.make_ahead: Boil, dry and rub the cauliflower up to 1 day ahead and keep it covered in the fridge; roast it and cook the sides on the night

steps.text: Boil the whole cauliflower for 8 minutes, drain well and let it steam dry.
Rub most of the softened butter with lemon zest and juice, thyme and salt over the cauliflower and roast at 200C until golden, basting once.
Glaze the carrots in the rest of the softened butter and the sugar.
Boil and mash the potatoes with the butter for mash and cook the peas.
Serve everything on one big platter like a sixties advertisement.

veg.make_ahead: Bake the loaf until firm up to 1 day ahead, cool and keep wrapped in the fridge; reheat slices at 160C for 15 minutes

steps.text: Soak the breadcrumbs in the milk.
Fry the mushrooms and onion in the oil until dry and browned.
Mash half the lentils, then mix in the rest with the mushrooms, soaked crumbs, eggs and soy sauce.
Press into a lined loaf tin and glaze with the tomato sauce and brown sugar.
Bake at 180C until firm.
Rest before slicing.

veg.make_ahead: Trim and season the mushrooms up to 4 hours ahead in the fridge; sear and make the sauce on the night

steps.text: Wipe the mushrooms, trim the stalks flush and season with the salt.
Sear the mushrooms hard in the neutral oil in a very hot pan, gill side up first, then turn and cook until tender.
Add the butter and rosemary and baste the mushrooms. Lift onto a warm plate.
In the same pan, crush in the peppercorns, add the brandy and flame it carefully.
Add the stock and cream and reduce until the sauce coats a spoon.
Pour the sauce over the mushrooms.

veg_af.make_ahead: Trim and season the mushrooms up to 4 hours ahead in the fridge; sear and make the sauce on the night

steps.text: Wipe the mushrooms, trim the stalks flush and season with the salt.
Sear the mushrooms hard in the neutral oil in a very hot pan, gill side up first, then turn and cook until tender.
Add the butter and rosemary and baste the mushrooms. Lift onto a warm plate.
In the same pan, crush in the peppercorns, add the vinegar and let it bubble away for a few seconds.
Add the stock and cream and reduce until the sauce coats a spoon.
Pour the sauce over the mushrooms.

veg.make_ahead: Marinate the mushrooms up to 4 hours ahead in the fridge; make the salsa up to 2 hours ahead

steps.text: Toss the mushrooms with the chipotle, juice of 2 limes, oil and salt.
Leave to marinate for 20 minutes.
Grill the mushrooms on a very hot griddle until charred and tender.
Mix the pineapple with onion and the remaining lime juice for salsa.
Fill warm tortillas with mushrooms, salsa and sour cream.

veg.make_ahead: The gumbo keeps up to 2 days in the fridge; reheat gently and cook the rice on the night

steps.text: Dice the onion, capsicum and celery and slice the sausages, mushrooms and okra.
Brown the sausages and mushrooms in 1 tbsp of the oil, then lift out.
Cook the flour in the remaining oil, stirring, until dark brown.
Add the onion, capsicum and celery and soften them.
Add the okra, beans, paprika and stock and simmer, cooking the rice while it bubbles.
Return the sausages and mushrooms, simmer 5 minutes and serve over the rice.

veg.make_ahead: Halve, score and rub the pumpkin up to 1 day ahead, covered in the fridge; roast and make the gravy on the day

steps.text: Halve the pumpkin lengthways, scoop out the seeds and score the flesh. Rub with 2 tbsp of the oil, the fennel, garlic and salt.
Roast at 200C with apple and onion around it and the potatoes tossed in the remaining oil alongside.
Tip the pan juices into a small pan, stir in the flour, whisk in the stock and simmer into gravy.
Cut the pumpkin into thick slices and spoon over the gravy.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 1 day, assemble then bake

steps.text: Dice the onion and carrots and chop the mushrooms. Peel and chop the potatoes.
Brown the mushrooms with the onion and carrot in the oil.
Add the lentils, tomato paste, soy sauce and stock and simmer until thick.
Boil the potatoes and mash with the butter and milk.
Top the lentil mix with mash and bake at 200C until golden.

veg.n: Dinner for twelve red wine braised mushrooms
veg.make_ahead: Braise up to 2 days ahead

ingredients.item: mixed portobello and king oyster mushrooms, in big pieces

steps.text: Season and brown the mushrooms in the oil in batches.
Add the onion, garlic and tomato paste and cook for 5 minutes.
Add the wine, stock, lentils and thyme. Cover and simmer gently until the lentils are tender.
Uncover and reduce the sauce until glossy and coating the mushrooms.
Cook the polenta in the water, stirring, then beat in the butter and cheese.
Spoon the mushrooms over the polenta.

veg_af.n: Dinner for twelve red wine braised mushrooms

ingredients.item: mixed portobello and king oyster mushrooms, in big pieces

steps.text: Season and brown the mushrooms in the oil in batches.
Add the onion, garlic and tomato paste and cook for 5 minutes.
Add the vinegar, stock, lentils and thyme. Cover and simmer gently until the lentils are tender.
Uncover and reduce the sauce until glossy and coating the mushrooms.
Cook the polenta in the water, stirring, then beat in the butter and cheese.
Spoon the mushrooms over the polenta.

veg.make_ahead: Salt and slice the tofu and mix the herb crumb up to 1 day ahead and keep both chilled. Crumb and roast the tofu on the night

steps.text: Pat the tofu dry, cut into 4 thick slabs and season with salt.
Mix the breadcrumbs with the oil, chopped dill, parsley and lemon zest.
Brush the tofu with the mustard, press on the crumbs and roast at 200C until golden.
Boil the potatoes and toss with the rest of the herbs.
Steam the asparagus.
Plate with lemon wedges.

veg.make_ahead: Slice the vegetables and drain the chickpeas and artichokes up to 1 day ahead in the fridge; cook just before serving

steps.text: Slice the onion, capsicum and mushrooms, trim the beans and drain the chickpeas and artichokes.
Fry the mushrooms and chickpeas in the oil with 1 tsp of the paprika in a wide pan until browned, then add the onion, capsicum and garlic.
Add the rice, saffron, remaining paprika and stock and simmer without stirring.
Scatter over the beans and artichokes and cover until the rice is tender.
Serve from the pan with lemon wedges.

veg.n: Mary Clarence's convent stew, spiced up (vegetarian)
veg.make_ahead: Better the next day, keep chilled

steps.text: Brown the mushrooms in the oil in batches.
Add the onions, garlic, paprika and thyme and cook until soft.
Chop the potatoes and carrots.
Add the stock, tomatoes, hot sauce, potatoes and carrots, cover and simmer until tender.
Stir in the butter beans and simmer uncovered until thick.

veg.n: Warrens' New England banana blossom bake
veg.make_ahead: Flake the banana blossom and mix the crumb up to 1 day ahead, kept chilled; assemble and bake on the night

ingredients.item: cans banana blossom in brine (about 510 g each), drained

steps.text: Pat the banana blossom dry, pull into chunky flakes, toss with the lemon juice and salt and lay in a baking dish.
Melt 80 g of the butter and mix with the crackers, lemon zest and parsley, then press on top.
Bake at 200C until the crust is golden.
Boil the potatoes until tender and cook the peas. Toss both with the remaining butter.

veg.make_ahead: Squeeze and shape the hash browns up to 2 hours ahead, chilled; fry the mushrooms and eggs on the morning

steps.text: Grate the potatoes and squeeze dry in a tea towel. Season with some of the salt and shape into 4 hash browns.
Fry the hash browns in some of the butter over medium heat, turning once.
Fry the mushrooms in the oil with a knob of the butter, the garlic and the remaining salt until tender and browned.
Fry the eggs in butter.
Toast the sourdough and butter it. Serve two mushrooms, two eggs, a hash brown and a toast each.

veg.make_ahead: Best cooked just before serving; slice the mushrooms up to 1 day ahead and keep chilled

steps.text: Bake the hash browns at 220C until crisp.
Fry the sausages in half the oil over medium heat, turning.
Fry the mushrooms in the remaining oil with the smoked paprika until dark and crisp at the edges.
Warm the baked beans.
Whisk the eggs with the milk and salt and cook in some of the butter over low heat, stirring gently, until just set.
Toast and butter the bread. Pile everything onto big plates with tomato sauce.

veg.make_ahead: Assemble up to 1 day ahead and keep covered in the fridge; bake on the night, adding 10 minutes

steps.text: Brown the mushrooms in the oil.
Add the onion, carrots, lentils, tomato paste, soy sauce and stock and simmer until thick.
Boil the potatoes and mash with butter.
Top the lentil mix with mash and bake at 200C until golden.

veg.make_ahead: Better the next day, keeps 3 days chilled

steps.text: Soften the leeks in the butter in a large pot.
Add the stock, barley and split peas and simmer gently, skimming now and then.
Add the carrots, swede and butter beans and simmer until everything is soft.
Season and finish with parsley.
Serve with crusty bread.

veg.make_ahead: Cook the onions up to 2 days ahead and shape the bean patties up to 1 day ahead, chilled; fry the patties and sandwiches on the night

steps.text: Slowly fry the onions in some of the butter.
Mash the black beans with the breadcrumbs, egg, paprika, cumin and salt and shape into four thin oval patties.
Fry the patties in the oil for 3 minutes a side until crusted.
Layer each patty on buttered rye with Swiss cheese and onions.
Fry the sandwiches until golden and melted.

veg.n: Roller diner mushroom and haloumi burgers
veg.make_ahead: Mix the burger sauce up to 3 days ahead in the fridge; fry the chips and cook the mushrooms and haloumi on the night

steps.text: Fry the potatoes once at a gentle heat until soft, drain, then fry again at a higher heat until crisp.
Mix the mayonnaise and relish for burger sauce.
Brush the mushrooms with a little of the oil and cook on a smoking griddle, pressing them flat with a spatula, until tender. Add cheese to melt.
Sear the haloumi on the griddle until golden on both sides.
Stack a mushroom and a slice of haloumi in each bun with pickles, onion and sauce.

veg.make_ahead: Chop the hearts of palm and mix the filling up to 1 day ahead in the fridge; toast the buns on the night

steps.text: Pat the hearts of palm dry and chop into chunks.
Fold with the mayonnaise, lemon juice, celery, chives, paprika and salt.
Butter and toast the cut sides of the buns.
Pile the filling in.

veg.make_ahead: Cut the potatoes into shoestrings up to 1 day ahead and keep in cold water in the fridge; make the garlic butter up to 3 days ahead. Cook the cauliflower steaks and fry the chips on the night

steps.text: Heat the oven to 200C. Cut two thick steaks from the centre of each cauliflower and season with the salt.
Mash the butter with the garlic and parsley.
Fry the shoestring potatoes in the oil until golden and crisp.
Sear the cauliflower in a smoking cast iron pan with 1 tbsp of the oil for 4 minutes a side, then roast until tender in the middle.
Top with the garlic butter and let it melt over.

veg.n: Tala and Abe's wedding tofu tacos
veg.make_ahead: Best fresh

steps.text: Quickly pickle the sliced red onion in some of the lime juice.
Mix the sour cream with lime juice for a crema and shred the cabbage.
Pat the tofu dry, cut into fingers and toss with the cornflour, chilli, cumin and salt.
Pan fry the tofu in the oil until crisp on all sides.
Warm the tortillas and fill with cabbage, tofu, crema and pickled onion.

veg.make_ahead: Rub and wrap the eggplant up to 4 hours ahead in the fridge; bake, glaze and grill to serve

ingredients.item: medium eggplants, cut lengthways into thick wedges

steps.text: Rub the eggplant with the oil, five spice, brown sugar, crushed garlic and salt.
Wrap in foil.
Bake at 180C until soft right through.
Mix the hoisin with honey and unwrap the eggplant.
Brush with the glaze and glaze under the grill.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 2 days, reheats well

steps.text: Brown the mushrooms in the oil in batches.
Add the onions and soften, stir in the flour, then pour in the stout and stock.
Add the soy sauce, butter beans and thyme and simmer gently until thick and glossy.
Boil the potatoes, mash with plenty of butter and serve the stew on top.
Brown the mushrooms in the oil in batches.
Add the onions and soften, stir in the flour, then pour in the stock, vinegar and brown sugar.
Add the soy sauce, butter beans and thyme and simmer gently until thick and glossy.
Boil the potatoes, mash with plenty of butter and serve the stew on top.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 1 day, bake fresh

steps.text: Brown the plant-based mince in the oil with the onion and mushrooms.
Stir in the corn, beans and cream. Tip into a baking dish and cover with potato gems.
Bake at 200C for 35 minutes until golden.

veg.make_ahead: Rub and wrap the cauliflower up to 4 hours ahead in the fridge; bake, char and dress the coleslaw on the night

ingredients.item: small cauliflowers, cut into thick wedges

steps.text: Rub the cauliflower with the oil, paprika, sugar and salt and wrap in foil.
Bake at 180C until just tender.
Brush with barbecue sauce and char over hot coals.
Shred the cabbage, grate the carrot and toss with mayonnaise for coleslaw.

veg.make_ahead: Shape the black bean patties up to 1 day ahead and keep chilled; griddle just before serving

steps.text: Fry the mushrooms in half the oil until dry, then cool.
Mash the black beans with the mushrooms, breadcrumbs, egg, salt and pepper, shape into four thick patties and chill for 15 minutes.
Griddle the patties in the remaining oil over medium-high heat for 4 minutes a side, topping with cheddar in the last minute.
Toast the buns cut-side down. Assemble with the patties, raw onion and pickles.

veg.make_ahead: Tofu and eggs up to 1 day ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Sear the tofu in the oil until golden, then add the soy, mirin, sake and water and simmer gently, turning once, until the tofu is glazed.
Soft-boil the eggs, peel and marinate in some of the braising liquid.
Heat the stock with the dried shiitake and season with a little of the braising liquid.
Cook the noodles and divide between bowls.
Ladle over the stock and top with tofu, halved egg, nori and spring onion.

veg_af.make_ahead: Tofu and eggs up to 1 day ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Sear the tofu in the oil until golden, then add the soy, brown sugar, rice vinegar and water and simmer gently, turning once, until the tofu is glazed.
Soft-boil the eggs, peel and marinate in some of the braising liquid.
Heat the stock with the dried shiitake and season with a little of the braising liquid.
Cook the noodles and divide between bowls.
Ladle over the stock and top with tofu, halved egg, nori and spring onion.

veg.n: Feud's-over roast cauliflower with cranberry glaze
veg.make_ahead: Mix the stuffing up to 1 day ahead, chilled; boil, rub and roast the cauliflower, glaze it and cook the potatoes on the day

steps.text: Boil the whole cauliflower for 8 minutes, drain and steam dry. Rub with some of the butter and the salt.
Roast at 200C until golden and tender.
Simmer the cranberry sauce with the orange juice and honey and brush over the cauliflower for the last 15 minutes of roasting.
Fry the onion, mix with the breadcrumbs, sage, egg and melted butter and bake in a dish. Roast the potatoes in oil alongside.
Toss the beans in butter and serve.

veg.n: Arendelle leek and banana blossom stew
veg.make_ahead: Best the day it is made

ingredients.item: can banana blossom in brine (about 510 g), drained

steps.text: Slice the leeks and dice the potatoes. Pull the banana blossom into bite-size pieces and drain the beans.
Soften the leeks in the butter.
Add the potatoes, stock and nori and simmer until tender.
Add the banana blossom and beans and heat through.
Stir in the cream and dill and serve with rye bread.

veg.make_ahead: Boil the potatoes and make the salad up to 1 day ahead in the fridge; salt, crumb and fry the eggplant on the night

steps.text: Boil the potatoes until tender, slice and toss while warm with vinegar, 2 tbsp of the oil and onion.
Sprinkle the eggplant with salt and leave 10 minutes, pat dry, then crumb in flour, egg and panko.
Fry in the butter and remaining oil in batches until golden and soft inside.
Serve with the potato salad, sliced cucumber and lemon.

veg.make_ahead: Chilli up to 2 days, reheats well

ingredients.item: onions, one diced and one finely diced to serve

steps.text: Fry the mushrooms and diced onion in the oil until browned.
Add the lentils, cumin, cinnamon, chilli powder, cocoa, tomatoes and stock and simmer until thick.
Cook the spaghetti.
Pile into bowls, ladle over the chilli and top with cheddar and finely diced onion.

veg.n: Peter's haloumi with lemon and capers
veg.make_ahead: Cut the chips and slice the haloumi up to 4 hours ahead, chilled; fry both just before serving

steps.text: Cut the potatoes into chips and season the flour with pepper.
Fry the chips in the oil twice, once low and once hot, until crisp, and salt them.
Dust the haloumi in the flour and fry in the butter for 2 minutes a side until golden.
Add lemon juice, capers and parsley to the pan.
Serve with a green salad.

veg.make_ahead: Assemble a day ahead, bake on the day

steps.text: Brown the mushrooms in the oil with the onion and garlic.
Add the lentils and passata and simmer.
Mix the ricotta with the egg.
Layer the lasagne sheets, ricotta mix and sauce in a dish, finishing with mozzarella.
Bake at 180C.
Rest before cutting.

veg.n: Late-pizza smoky mushroom and pineapple pie
veg.make_ahead: Dough can be made a day ahead

steps.text: Rest the dough at room temperature so it relaxes.
Toss the mushrooms with the smoked paprika and oil.
Stretch the dough thin and spread with sauce. Top with the mozzarella, mushrooms, pineapple and jalapeno.
Bake on a preheated tray at the oven's highest setting until golden and bubbling, one pie at a time.

veg.make_ahead: Best served hot

steps.text: Heat the oven to 200C. Rub the cauliflowers with 2 tbsp of the oil, salt and pepper and roast until deep golden and tender.
Roast the potatoes in 2 tbsp of the oil.
Toss the carrots and parsnips with honey and the remaining oil and roast.
For the gravy, melt the butter, stir in the flour, add the red wine and reduce, then whisk in the stock and simmer.
Carve the cauliflowers into thick wedges at the table.
Heat the oven to 200C. Rub the cauliflowers with 2 tbsp of the oil, salt and pepper and roast until deep golden and tender.
Roast the potatoes in 2 tbsp of the oil.
Toss the carrots and parsnips with honey and the remaining oil and roast.
For the gravy, melt the butter, stir in the flour, whisk in the stock and vinegar and simmer.
Carve the cauliflowers into thick wedges at the table.

veg.make_ahead: Make the chilli up to 3 days ahead in the fridge or 2 months ahead frozen; reheat and cook the spaghetti fresh

steps.text: Fry the plant-based mince in the oil, breaking it up fine.
Add the stock, onion, tomatoes, chilli powder, cinnamon, cumin, allspice, soy sauce and chocolate.
Simmer until thick.
Cook the spaghetti.
Ladle the chilli over the spaghetti and pile the cheddar on top.

veg.n: Prom night haloumi in mushroom cream
veg.make_ahead: Gratin can be made 1 day ahead

steps.text: Slice the potatoes thin, layer in a dish with part of the cream and the garlic, and bake at 160C.
Pan-fry the haloumi in the butter with thyme until golden on both sides, then lift out.
Fry the mushrooms in the same pan and add the remaining cream to make a sauce. Return the haloumi to warm through.
Steam the beans and serve everything together.

veg.make_ahead: Butter up to 2 days ahead

steps.text: Score the cut side of the mushrooms. Mash the butter with the garlic, lemon zest and parsley and brush over them.
Cut the potatoes into shoestrings, rinse and dry well.
Fry the potatoes in the oil in batches at 180C until crisp, drain and salt.
Grill the mushrooms for about 4 minutes a side until golden and tender.
Dress the salad leaves in lemon juice and serve with the mushrooms and fries.

veg.make_ahead: Marinate the mushrooms in the fridge for 30 minutes up to 2 hours ahead; sear and serve on the night

steps.text: Marinate the mushrooms in the lime and orange juice, crushed garlic, cumin, salt and oil.
Sear over very high heat until charred and tender.
Slice into strips.
Warm the tortillas. Chop the onion and coriander.
Serve in tortillas with onion, coriander and salsa roja.

veg.make_ahead: Curry up to 2 days, reheats well

steps.text: Fry the tofu in the oil until golden, then lift out.
Fry the curry paste in the same pan until fragrant.
Pour in the coconut milk and soy sauce and simmer, adding the tofu and capsicum for the last 5 minutes.
Cook the rice. Stir the Thai basil through the curry and serve with the rice.

veg.n: Greater good mushroom and ale pie
veg.make_ahead: Filling up to 2 days ahead

steps.text: Brown the mushrooms in the olive oil in batches and soften the sliced onions.
Add thyme, ale, stock, soy sauce and lentils. Cover and simmer gently until rich and dark.
Thicken the sauce with the flour mixed to a paste, simmer, then tip into a pie dish and cool slightly.
Top with puff pastry, brush with beaten egg and bake at 200C until puffed and golden.
Cut the potatoes into chips, fry in the vegetable oil until golden, and boil the peas. Serve alongside.

veg_af.n: Greater good mushroom and ale pie

steps.text: Brown the mushrooms in the olive oil in batches and soften the sliced onions.
Add thyme, malt vinegar, stock, soy sauce and lentils. Cover and simmer gently until rich and dark.
Thicken the sauce with the flour mixed to a paste, simmer, then tip into a pie dish and cool slightly.
Top with puff pastry, brush with beaten egg and bake at 200C until puffed and golden.
Cut the potatoes into chips, fry in the vegetable oil until golden, and boil the peas. Serve alongside.

veg.make_ahead: Better the next day, keep chilled

steps.text: Toast the dried chillies and soak in hot water.
Blend the chillies with garlic and a little of the soaking water.
Fry the mushrooms and onion in the oil until browned.
Add the stock, chilli sauce, hominy and beans and simmer.
Serve with cabbage, radish, oregano and lime.

veg.make_ahead: Boil and butter the cauliflower and make the stuffing up to 1 day ahead in the fridge; roast on the day and make the gravy fresh

steps.text: Heat the oven to 200C. Boil the cauliflower for 8 minutes, drain and steam dry.
Mash most of the butter with the thyme leaves and salt and push it in between the florets.
Roast until deep golden and tender right through.
Make the stuffing as the packet says.
Melt the remaining butter, stir in the flour, whisk in the stock and simmer into gravy.

veg.make_ahead: Fry the mushrooms and mix and chill the meatball mixture up to 1 day ahead; roll, brown and simmer on the night

ingredients.item: vegetarian parmesan-style cheese, grated, plus extra to serve

steps.text: Fry the mushrooms in half the oil until dry, then cool.
Mix the mushrooms with the ricotta, breadcrumbs, cheese, chopped parsley and egg and chill for 10 minutes.
Roll into balls and brown gently in the remaining oil.
Add the tomatoes and simmer.
Cook the spaghetti.
Serve the meatballs over the spaghetti with extra cheese.

veg.n: Hideaway Tom's crisp banana blossom and chips
veg.make_ahead: Eat straight away

ingredients.item: cans banana blossom in brine (about 510 g each), drained

steps.text: Bake the chips at 220C.
Whisk the flour, baking powder and cold soda water into a batter, keeping a little flour back.
Pat the banana blossom dry and press into 8 fillet shapes. Sprinkle with the nori, dust in the saved flour and dip in the batter.
Fry in the oil at 180C until golden.
Mix the mayonnaise with chopped capers, pickles and dill for tartare.
Toss the chips in the celery salt and paprika and serve wrapped in paper with lemon.

veg.n: Barton Academy Christmas stuffed roast pumpkin
veg.make_ahead: Make the stuffing up to 1 day ahead, covered in the fridge; halve, fill and roast the pumpkin on the day

steps.text: Fry the onion in some of the butter, then mix with the breadcrumbs, sage, lemon zest and egg.
Halve the pumpkins lengthways and scoop out the seeds. Rub with butter and salt and roast cut side down at 200C.
Turn the pumpkins over, pack the stuffing into the hollows and roast until golden. Roast the potatoes in oil on another tray.
Glaze the carrots in butter and honey.
Pour off the roasting juices, stir in the flour, whisk in the stock and simmer into gravy.

veg.make_ahead: Soak the mushrooms in the buttermilk and salt up to 2 hours ahead in the fridge; dredge and fry on the night

steps.text: Soak the mushrooms in the buttermilk with a pinch of salt for 30 minutes.
Peel and boil the potatoes, then mash with butter.
Dredge the mushrooms in the flour seasoned with paprika and salt, pressing it into the folds.
Fry in the oil at 170C in batches until deep golden and crisp.
Simmer the stock with a spoonful of the leftover flour to make a gravy and serve with the mash.

veg.make_ahead: Fry the mushrooms and mix and roll the lentil meatballs up to 1 day ahead, covered in the fridge; brown, simmer and boil the spaghetti on the night

steps.text: Fry the mushrooms and garlic in 1 tbsp of the oil until dry, then cool.
Mash the lentils with the mushrooms, breadcrumbs, egg and cheese, roll into 8 big meatballs and chill for 10 minutes.
Brown the meatballs gently all over in the remaining oil.
Add the passata and simmer gently.
Boil the spaghetti until al dente and drain.
Serve the meatballs and sauce over the spaghetti.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 1 day, assemble then bake

steps.text: Dice the onion and carrots and chop the mushrooms. Peel the potatoes and cut into chunks.
Brown the mushrooms hard in the oil in a large pan, then add the onion and carrot and cook a few minutes.
Stir in the lentils, tomato paste, soy sauce and stock and simmer until thick. Season with salt and pepper.
Boil the potatoes until soft, drain and mash with the butter.
Spoon the lentil mix into a baking dish, top with mash and fork the surface. Bake at 200C until golden.

veg.make_ahead: Mushrooms can be roasted 1 day ahead

steps.text: Toss the mushrooms with the orange and lime juice, garlic, oregano, oil and salt.
Leave to marinate for 1 hour.
Roast at 200C on a tray until browned and juicy.
Layer the rolls with mushrooms, smoked tofu, Swiss, pickles and mustard.
Press and griddle in butter until crisp and the cheese melts.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 3 days, reheat well

steps.text: Dice the vegetables and slice the sausages. Shred the cabbage.
Brown the sausages in the oil in a big pot, lift out, then add the onion, carrots and potatoes and cook.
Add the paprika, beans, tomatoes and stock and simmer, adding the cabbage and sausages for the last 10 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper and serve in mugs.

veg.make_ahead: Wellington can be rolled 1 day ahead, gravy and carrots 1 hour ahead

steps.text: Fry the mushrooms in 1 tbsp of the oil until all the liquid has gone, add the spinach to wilt, season and cool.
Heat the oven to 220C. Spread the mushroom mix along the overlapped pastry sheets, roll into a log, seal, brush with the beaten egg and bake until deep golden.
Roast the potatoes in 2 tbsp of the oil alongside.
Whisk the remaining 3 eggs, 150 g of the flour and the milk and bake Yorkshires in tins heated with the last of the oil at 220C.
Glaze the carrots with honey and roast.
For the gravy, melt the butter with the remaining flour, add the red wine and reduce, then whisk in the stock and simmer.

veg_af.make_ahead: Wellington can be rolled 1 day ahead, gravy and carrots 1 hour ahead

steps.text: Fry the mushrooms in 1 tbsp of the oil until all the liquid has gone, add the spinach to wilt, season and cool.
Heat the oven to 220C. Spread the mushroom mix along the overlapped pastry sheets, roll into a log, seal, brush with the beaten egg and bake until deep golden.
Roast the potatoes in 2 tbsp of the oil alongside.
Whisk the remaining 3 eggs, 150 g of the flour and the milk and bake Yorkshires in tins heated with the last of the oil at 220C.
Glaze the carrots with honey and roast.
For the gravy, melt the butter with the remaining flour, whisk in the stock and vinegar and simmer.

veg.make_ahead: Cut the cauliflower steaks and slice the fennel and lemons up to 1 day ahead; roast and whisk the sauce fresh

steps.text: Cut two thick steaks from the centre of each cauliflower. Lay on a tray with the lemon slices, sliced fennel and dill, drizzle with the oil and season with salt.
Roast at 220C for 25 minutes until golden and tender.
While the cauliflower roasts, boil the new potatoes in salted water until tender, about 20 minutes, then drain.
Reduce the shallot with the white wine and white wine vinegar until about 2 tbsp is left.
Take off the heat and whisk in the cold butter cube by cube until thick and glossy.
Serve the cauliflower and fennel with the potatoes and the sauce.

veg_af.make_ahead: Cut the cauliflower steaks up to 1 day ahead and chop the shallot; roast the cauliflower and whisk the sauce on the night

steps.text: Cut two thick steaks from the centre of each cauliflower. Lay on a tray with the lemon slices, sliced fennel and dill, drizzle with the oil and season with salt.
Roast at 220C for 25 minutes until golden and tender.
While the cauliflower roasts, boil the new potatoes in salted water until tender, about 20 minutes, then drain.
Reduce the shallot with the verjuice and white wine vinegar until about 2 tbsp is left.
Take off the heat and whisk in the cold butter cube by cube until thick and glossy.
Serve the cauliflower and fennel with the potatoes and the sauce.

veg.make_ahead: Simmer the coconut broth with the lime leaves, ginger, chilli and soy up to 1 day ahead and keep it chilled; reheat, poach the tofu and cook the rice on the night

steps.text: Cook the rice.
Simmer the coconut milk with lime leaves, ginger, chilli and soy sauce for 5 minutes.
Add the tofu and poach gently for 8 minutes so it soaks up the sauce.
Finish with lime juice and coriander.

veg.make_ahead: Cut the cauliflower steaks up to 1 day ahead and keep covered in the fridge; sear and roast on the night

steps.text: Heat the oven to 200C. Cut two thick steaks from the centre of each cauliflower and season with the salt.
Sear in the oil in a smoking ovenproof pan for 4 minutes a side, then add butter, garlic and thyme, baste and roast until tender.
Rest for 3 minutes.
Slice to share and spoon over the pan butter.

veg.make_ahead: Dough needs 1 to 2 days in the fridge

steps.text: Mix the flour, yeast, salt and water, then knead for about 8 minutes. Divide into 2 balls.
Cold-ferment the covered balls in the fridge for 24 hours (up to 48 is fine).
Bring the dough to room temperature for 2 hours.
Heat a pizza steel in the oven at its maximum temperature, about 250 to 275C. Toss the mushrooms with the smoked paprika and oil.
Stretch each ball thin, spread with half the tomatoes and top with half the mozzarella and mushrooms. Bake one at a time on the hot steel until the crust is cooked and crisp. Cut into wedges.

veg.n: Farmhouse mushroom and butter bean dumplings
veg.make_ahead: Make the stew up to 2 days ahead and keep it in the fridge; reheat, then mix and cook the dumplings on the night

steps.text: Slice the carrots, celery and onion.
Soften the vegetables and mushrooms in 20 g of the butter.
Add the stock and butter beans and simmer.
Rub the remaining butter into the flour, add parsley and enough milk for a soft dough.
Drop spoonfuls onto the stew, cover and cook.

veg.make_ahead: Wipe and trim the mushrooms up to 1 day ahead in the fridge; salt, sear and baste on the night

steps.text: Wipe the mushrooms, trim the stalks flush and salt them evenly.
Heat a heavy pan over high heat with the oil.
Sear the mushrooms in batches, gill side down first, turning once.
Lower the heat, add the butter, thyme and garlic and baste repeatedly.
Slice the mushrooms and spoon over the pan butter.

veg.make_ahead: Simmer the tomato sauce up to 2 days ahead in the fridge; assemble and bake on the night

steps.text: Press the dough into a 26cm cast iron pan or cake tin brushed with the olive oil, pushing it well up the sides.
Layer the mozzarella over the base, then the sausages crumbled into small pieces and the fennel seeds.
Simmer the tomatoes with the garlic, oregano and sugar, then spread over the top.
Scatter with the cheese and bake at 220C.
Rest before cutting.
